rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for statements or wording that is vague and open to multiple interpretations.

example.english: This statement is too ambiguous, and I don’t know what you mean.
example.traditional: 呢句說話太含糊，我唔知你想點。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 taai3 ham4 wu4 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 dim2

rows.note: Use this especially when someone's intentions, attitude, or relationship is unclear or deliberately suggestive.

example.english: Their attitude toward me is so ambiguous that I don’t know whether they like me.
example.traditional: 佢對我嘅態度好曖昧，我唔知佢係咪對我有意思。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 oi2 mui6 ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 mai6 deoi3 ngo5 jau5 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this formal expression when wording or a position can be read in two contrary ways.

example.english: This statement is ambiguous and can be interpreted in two opposite ways.
example.traditional: 呢份聲明模稜兩可，正反兩面都可以咁解。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 sing1 ming4 mou4 ling4 loeng5 ho2 zing3 faan2 loeng5 min6 dou1 ho2 ji5 gam2 gaai2
